review:
A peaceful 10-line game set in a secret garden. Golden key scatters unlock the free spins greenhouse.

Three keys give 10 free spins, and inside, winning combinations lock into wooden frames and keep paying on every following spin until the bonus ends. Low volatility, 2,000x max and 97% RTP, with free spins about once every 184 spins. Calm and gentle.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
